_about: Workbench data schema reconstructed from dconstruct .asm struct dumps (workbench-settings*.bin, weapon-upgrades.bin, player-upgrade-settings.bin) cross-referenced with the byte offsets read by ss-t2/ss-workbench.bin and workbench-script-funcs-impl.bin. Type names in quotes are the real DC type names printed by dconstruct; field names are analyst labels.
_confidence_legend: C = CONFIRMED (offset read in DC code and value seen in data); H = HIGH CONFIDENCE; I = INFERRED (from usage only); U = UNKNOWN (present in data, never read by DC)

workbench-state-def.instance: *curr-workbench-state* (workbench-settings.bin) - one global shared by every workbench

0x00: anim-state the world script is playing now; written before signal(curr-state-updated)

workbench-weapon-def.instances: *<weapon>-workbench-weapon* in workbench-settings-ellie/abby.bin, *t2r-<weapon>-workbench-weapon* in t2r-workbench-settings-*.bin, *invalid-workbench-weapon* (fallback) in workbench-settings.bin

0x010: parts object is a weapon process (spawn-weapon-process + bundles) instead of a SimpleObject
0x018: default magazine mesh on parts object
0x020: upgrade id that swaps the magazine mesh (e.g. increase-capacity)
0x028: bullet/shell mesh names on parts object (shown per ammo-in-clip)
0x030: consume a round on first disassemble this visit (weapons-disassembled-this-interact logic)
0x038: attach point for display weapon (leftHand everywhere)
0x068: default phase for backpack swap / flashlight-off during enter (0.10)
0x078: enter phase at which the HUD menu page is pushed (0.50)
0x090: default exit phase for flashlight-on / backpack swap
0x098: ap-ref channel for exit feather-blend (animate_ key 14)
0x0C8: idle camera anim (never read by DC)
0x0E0: pullout abort-blend times per abort range
0x0E8: pullout inverse-phase curve (putback phase -> pullout start phase)
0x100: PULLOUT (weapon from bag); its player anim also gates has-animation?
0x158: condition for alt disassemble (e.g. empty weapon)
0x190: assemble phase before honouring weapon-change / exit
0x1A0: default phase at which the visual upgrade is applied
0x1B8: ENTER override when lights are off (lamp-switch-on anims)
0x1C0: EXIT override when lights are on (lamp-switch-off anims)

0x08: camera (played on dummy camera object, animate_ key 85 = camera id)
0x38: per-state hook; script-lambda track polls it until it returns true (used for side effects such as set-weapon-extra-joint-mods)
0x40: backpack swap phase override (-1 = use weapon-def)
0x54: phase after which menu events may interrupt (enter only; -1 = never)

0x0C: always 2 in data; never read by DC
0x10: -> animate_ key 30 (usually 0.0; 0.75 on lamp variants). Meaning UNKNOWN
0x14: always 2 in data; never read by DC
0x1C: event phase A: attach weapon / lights-on / hide mag+bullets
0x20: event phase B: detach weapon / backpack weapons visibility / show mag
0x28: secondary (partial-layer) anim played with animate_ key 40=1

0x00: idle-on-table override after this upgrade is owned
0x08: assemble override after this upgrade is owned
0x10: disassemble override after this upgrade is owned
0x20: phase at which visual bundle is applied
0x48: extra mesh toggled on the parts object
0x50: combination overrides (anim/phases depend on already-owned upgrades)
0x58: hook evaluated during apply (e.g. reset weapons-disassembled-this-interact)

weapon-upgrade-bundles (cost data).instance: *weapon-upgrade-bundles* (weapon-upgrades.bin): map weapon -> weapon-upgrade-bundles {0x00 sid weapon, 0x08 weapon-visual-mods (base joints/shader blends), 0x10 weapon-upgrade-bundle-array}
weapon-upgrade-bundles (cost data).grounded: *weapon-upgrade-bundles-grounded-override* has the same shape for 5 weapons (name suggests Grounded difficulty; selection is native)

0x20: joint mods to show/hide + shader blend offsets when applied
0x30: [ {item sid (parts), uint32-array counts} ] = COST; DC reads counts[0] of entry 0
0x50: craft loop sfx (menu reads +80 of lookup-weapon-upgrade-by-bundle-id)

weapon-upgrades (stat data).instance: *weapon-upgrades*: map weapon -> map stat-type -> weapon-upgrade-set {0x00 int type, 0x04 count, 0x08 array of {.. 0x08 typed payload e.g. weapon-upgrade-recoil/silencer ..}}
weapon-upgrades (stat data).type_names: *weapon-upgrade-type-names* enum (28 entries: none, reload-speed, reload-multiple, fire-rate, clip-capacity, recoil, accuracy, stability, scope, scope-sway, ..., sway, penetration, range-finder-settings)

holster upgrades.instance: *holster-upgrades* = [short-gun-second-holster, long-gun-second-holster]; cost read as lookup-player-upgrade(id)+0x18 from *player-upgrades-defs-map* (player-upgrade-settings.bin); value 0 in data

script globals (module variables in work.all-weapons-acquired: d-array, rebuilt by world script from player-inv-selection-get-sub-slot-items-filtered(0)+(2) minus excluded-weapons; read by menu
script globals (module variables in work.excluded-weapons: rifle-mpx5, flamethrower, rifle-tommy-abby-player, pistol-revolver-joel-player, rifle-assault-firefly-ellie-player, shotgun-remington-pump-bill
script globals (module variables in work.excluded-upgrades: bayonet, silencer, scope-efp, fire-arrows, explosive-arrows, bipod-active, rangefinder-timed, rangefinder-smart, burst-fire-active
script globals (module variables in work.spawned-weapons-by-id / spawned-weapon-p: d-dict weapon -> spawned display weapon / parts object
script globals (module variables in work.upgrade-queue / weapon-queue: d-arrays appended by apply-upgrade-event (upgrade, weapon); head consumed at apply-upgrade end
